limitations: Additional synthetic challenge set only; not a replacement for the planned 24/24 development and holdout sets.
Labels and prompts are frozen before provider execution; no scored Jev calls were made.
Choice-only top-1 selection; do not compute ranking metrics from these cases.
E1 scores authorization only; risk is present in state but not a second gold label.
R1/R2 labels are routing-rubric screens, not end-to-end savings or quality evidence.
E7 none_additional is advisory targeting, not a waiver of required test gates.
Dangerous shell strings exist only as JSON data and were not executed.
Prompts are independent candidates; no development split existed here to select a winner.
Lexical baseline is not an oracle; 28/80 stored baseline labels differ from expected.
Authoring model for this worker was Grok 4.6, not the protocol's proposed GPT-5.6 Terra route.
Other workers' datasets were not read.
